outputs.explanation: Flow cytometry pseudocolor/dot plots where each point represents an individual cell event; these are scatter plots, not averaged summary statistics, so no additional overlay of individual points is needed.
Flow cytometry dot plots showing individual cell events used for gating (e.g., CD98/CD19, PC gate); already displays individual data points, no averaging depicted.
Flow cytometry scatter plots (IgM/IgD, Fas/NP, CD38/CD138) showing individual cell events for gating; scatter plots inherently show individual data points, not an average requiring overlay.

Color-coded overlay scatter plots (CD62L/CD44 and CD80/PD-L2) with each dot representing an individual cell from MBC, GC, or naive populations; this is a scatter plot of individual data, not a summary average.

Flow cytometry gating scatter plots (CD62L/CD44 and CD80/PD-L2) showing individual cell events with gate percentages; scatter plots of individual cells, no averaging that would require additional point overlay.
